name: AGRIS
description: International information system of the Food and Agriculture Organization indexing agricultural and food research literature from data providers in more than 150 countries, with links to open-access full texts.
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

name: Paperity
description: Multidisciplinary search engine indexing open-access scholarly literature from thousands of journals and repositories, with full-text search across papers in the sciences, medicine, and humanities.

name: LIVIVO
description: Life sciences search portal of ZB MED, the Leibniz Information Centre for Life Sciences, covering medicine, biology, ecology, and environmental research with literature records, datasets, and open-access links.
publisher: ZB MED Information Centre for Life Sciences

name: MyScienceWork
description: Platform combining a multidisciplinary publication database with researcher profiles, institutional archive services, and open-access dissemination tools, operated from Paris.

name: Wanfang Data
description: Chinese knowledge platform indexing journals, dissertations, conference proceedings, patents, and standards, widely used for Chinese-language scientific and technical literature discovery.

name: CyberLeninka
description: Open-access electronic library of Russian scholarly journals offering free full-text reading, citation metrics, and article-level statistics for millions of Russian-language research papers.

name: JURN
description: Free curated search service covering millions of open-access academic articles, chapters, and theses across the arts, humanities, social sciences, and sciences, built on a hand-maintained index of ejournals and repositories.

name: Open Archives Initiative (OAI-PMH)
description: Organization and protocol home for OAI-PMH, the Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting that lets repositories expose metadata for harvesting by service providers such as search engines and archives.

name: Handle.Net Registry
description: CNRI-operated registry for the Handle System, a general-purpose distributed identifier service that resolves persistent identifiers; DOI resolution and many data repositories run on handle infrastructure.

name: BIBFRAME
description: Library of Congress initiative providing BIBFRAME, the linked-data bibliographic framework model and vocabulary intended to replace MARC 21 for describing library resources on the web.

name: Open Syllabus
description: Nonprofit project collecting and analyzing university syllabi at scale to map curriculum and teaching patterns, offering the Open Syllabus Explorer for browsing works assigned in courses.

name: ROAR (Registry of Open Access Repositories)
description: EPrints-maintained registry tracking registered open-access institutional repositories and their growth, allowing browsing and comparison of repository contents and metadata harvesting status.

name: Citation Style Language
description: Community project home of CSL, the open XML format for describing citation and bibliography styles, with the official style repository used by citation managers such as Zotero and Pandoc.

name: BibSonomy
description: Social bookmarking and publication-sharing system from the University of Kassel that combines web bookmark management with BibTeX-based bibliographic tagging and community recommendation.

name: SCOAP3
description: Sponsoring Consortium for Open Access Publishing in Particle Physics, a CERN-hosted partnership that converts high-energy physics journals to open access through centrally negotiated agreements with publishers.

name: cOAlition S
description: Consortium of national research funders and charitable foundations coordinating Plan S, which requires immediate open access to publicly funded research outputs, with rights retention and journal comparison tools.

name: SciPost
description: Open-access scholar-led publishing platform run by the SciPost Foundation, operating peer-reviewed journals in physics, mathematics, and related fields with open peer review and no author fees.

name: Open Research Europe
description: Open-access publishing platform for European Commission and Horizon Europe funded researchers, publishing papers with open peer review and without author fees across all disciplines.

name: Wellcome Open Research
description: Open-research publishing platform for Wellcome funded researchers that publishes outputs rapidly, links underlying data, and attaches open post-publication peer review to each article.

name: Gates Open Research
description: Publishing platform for Gates Foundation grantees combining rapid open-access publication, invited open peer review, and mandatory sharing of underlying data and code.

name: Knowledge Unlatched
description: Initiative and service provider that pools library contributions to fund open-access books and journals across the humanities and social sciences, hosting collections and usage analytics.

name: OSF Preprints
description: Preprint hosting and discovery service from the Center for Open Science that aggregates preprints from partner servers across disciplines and supports moderation, search, and DOI registration.

name: EconPapers
description: RePEc service providing search and download of economics working papers and articles, with author contact details, citation listings, and software components for the RePEc digital library.

name: SciELO Preprints
description: Preprint service of the SciELO program for Ibero-American research, publishing open preprints with DOI registration and linking to journal versions across sciences, health, and social sciences.

name: AfricArXiv
description: Community-led African preprint service hosting submissions on the Open Science Framework and supporting preprint discovery, translation, and peer review for research from and about Africa.

name: Review Commons
description: Journal-independent peer review service from EMBO Press and Nature Portfolio in which papers are refereed before journal submission and the reviews with author responses are transferred to journals.

name: BioHackrXiv
description: Preprint server for BioHackathon outcomes hosted on the Open Science Framework, giving project reports from bioinformatics and life-science hackathons a citable, open home.

name: Octopus
description: Free open-research publishing service run by Jisc that publishes work as linked records covering problems, methods, results, and interpretations, each with open peer review.

name: EliScholar
description: Yale University Library digital platform for scholarly publishing, hosting Yale journals, working papers, datasets, and other research and teaching materials in open access.

name: VTechWorks
description: Virginia Tech open institutional repository holding faculty and student research, theses, dissertations, and university publications maintained by the University Libraries.

name: UvA DARE
description: Digital Academic Repository of the University of Amsterdam containing open-access publications, theses, and datasets by UvA researchers with full-text downloads where rights allow.

name: ORBi
description: Open Repository and Bibliography of the University of Liege, mandating deposit of university research outputs and providing open-access full texts and bibliographic records.

name: Shodhganga
description: Indian national repository maintained by the INFLIBNET Centre hosting electronic theses and dissertations submitted by Indian universities under the UGC scheme, with full-text access.

name: MINDS@UW
description: Institutional repository of the University of Wisconsin system collecting research and scholarship from its campuses, including theses, reports, datasets, and faculty publications.

name: ScholarsArchive@OSU
description: Oregon State University institutional repository storing faculty and student scholarship, electronic theses and dissertations, datasets, and open educational resources.

name: OMIM
description: Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man, the continuously updated Johns Hopkins compendium of human genes, genetic phenotypes, and gene-phenotype relationships used worldwide in clinical genetics.
access_requirements: Free registration required for API access

name: Orphanet
description: Reference portal for rare diseases and orphan drugs providing expert-reviewed encyclopedia entries, disease classifications, and prevalence data coordinated by the French research institute INSERM.

name: SEER (Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program)
description: National Cancer Institute program collecting population-based cancer incidence and survival data from US registries, publishing cancer statistics and supporting research data submissions.

name: Human Phenotype Ontology
description: Standardized vocabulary of phenotypic abnormalities in human disease maintained at the Jackson Laboratory, used in diagnostics, computational phenotyping, and cross-species integration, with downloads and an API.

name: LOINC
description: International standard terminology for laboratory tests, clinical observations, and measurements maintained by the Regenstrief Institute, offering free codes, mappings, and related terminologies.

name: SNOMED International
description: Global membership organization stewarding SNOMED CT, the multilingual clinical terminology used in electronic health records worldwide, with licensing managed through member countries and affiliates.
access_requirements: SNOMED CT use depends on member country or affiliate license

name: Uppsala Monitoring Centre
description: WHO Collaborating Centre in Uppsala operating VigiBase, the global database of individual case safety reports, supporting national pharmacovigilance programs worldwide with signal detection tools.
access_requirements: Full database access limited to national pharmacovigilance programs

name: Sri Lanka Clinical Trials Registry
description: Primary registry of the WHO ICTRP network registering clinical trials conducted in Sri Lanka, with publicly searchable trial records covering objectives, interventions, and outcome measures.

name: Vivli
description: Nonprofit data-sharing platform hosting individual participant data from completed clinical trials, supporting request-based access under data use agreements and linking to funder and journal policies.
access_requirements: Data requests reviewed under data use agreements

name: YODA Project
description: Yale School of Medicine clinical data sharing initiative that brokers requests for clinical trial data from industry and academic sponsors, housing data packages under registered data use agreements.

name: CTTI (Clinical Trials Transformation Initiative)
description: Public-private partnership co-founded by Duke University and the FDA developing practical recommendations to improve the quality and conduct of clinical trials, with published projects and toolkits.

name: European Medicines Agency
description: European Union agency for the scientific evaluation and supervision of medicines, publishing clinical trial and marketing authorization information, safety communications, and regulatory guidance.

name: The Global Health Network
description: Knowledge-sharing network for health research teams worldwide offering free methodological guidance, training resources, and career development for clinical and public health research in low-resource settings.

name: MRCT Center (Multi-Regional Clinical Trials Center)
description: Harvard and Brigham and Women's Hospital center addressing practical and ethical challenges of multi-regional clinical trials through guidance, toolkits, and multi-stakeholder working groups.
publisher: Brigham and Women's Hospital and Harvard University

name: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
description: Authoritative open reference on the special functions of applied mathematics, successor to the Handbook of Mathematical Functions by Abramowitz and Stegun, with formulas, references, and rendered mathematics.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: AFLOW
description: Materials informatics framework from Duke University offering high-throughput computation of material properties, repositories of ab-initio results, and search tools for materials discovery.

name: NIST JARVIS
description: NIST database of computed materials properties from density functional theory and classical force fields, including the JARVIS force field set and tools for materials screening.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: SDBS (Spectral Database for Organic Compounds)
description: Japanese national institute database of organic compound spectra including electron ionization mass, NMR, IR, Raman, and ESR spectra, freely searchable by compound name, formula, or structure.
publisher: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology

name: IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry)
description: Global federation of national chemistry organizations that sets chemical nomenclature, terminology, and measurement standards and publishes recommendations, projects, and the Gold Book.
publisher: International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry

name: SIAM (Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics)
description: Professional society for industrial and applied mathematics publishing peer-reviewed journals, organizing major conferences, and supporting education in computational science and engineering.
publisher: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics

name: OPTIMADE
description: Open standard and REST API specification enabling unified programmatic access to many materials databases, developed by a consortium of computational materials science providers.

name: CSRankings
description: Transparent, methodology-first ranking of computer science departments based exclusively on publications at selected top venues, with open code and data on GitHub.

name: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)
description: Flagship international machine learning conference publishing peer-reviewed proceedings, tutorials, and workshops, with papers and abstracts openly available on its conference sites.

name: The Web Conference (WWW)
description: Official site of the annual Web Conference continuing the World Wide Web conference series, a major peer-reviewed forum for web research covering mining, semantics, security, and society.
publisher: International World Wide Web Conferences Steering Committee

name: Google Research
description: Google research division site publishing papers, open datasets, tools, and blog posts across machine learning, systems, health, and the sciences, with a public publications search.

name: Microsoft Research
description: Microsoft research organization site with publications, projects, open tools and datasets across AI, systems, and human-computer interaction, plus the Microsoft Research blog and events.

name: IBM Research
description: IBM global research arm site publishing scientific papers, blog posts, and open projects in quantum computing, semiconductors, AI, and hybrid cloud, with its publication index browsable.

name: ACM SIGACT
description: ACM Special Interest Group on Algorithms and Computation Theory supporting theoretical computer science with the STOC conference, awards, news, and resources for the theory community.

name: ACM SIGMOD
description: ACM Special Interest Group on Management of Data supporting database research with the SIGMOD conference, the SIGMOD Record newsletter, awards, and community resources.

name: OPUS
description: Open collection of parallel corpora and translation models assembled from public web sources, supporting machine translation research and multilingual natural language processing experiments.

name: Tatoeba
description: Community-built collection of example sentences and their translations in many languages, freely reusable under open licenses and widely used in language learning and multilingual NLP research.

name: Allen Institute for AI
description: Nonprofit AI research institute publishing open models, datasets, and benchmarks such as OLMo and Tulu, with research papers, interactive demos, and open-source code.

name: Mila
description: Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, a major academic deep learning research institute publishing research, open-source tools, and interdisciplinary AI projects across its member universities.

name: Partnership on AI
description: Multi-stakeholder nonprofit bringing together industry, civil society, and academia to develop shared guidance and frameworks for safe and responsible artificial intelligence systems.

name: DataComp
description: Benchmark suite and community competition for dataset curation in multimodal model training, providing large filtered image-text pools and public leaderboards for data-centric research.
access_requirements: Signed data agreement required to download the dataset

name: LiveBench
description: Contamination-free large language model benchmark that regularly releases new questions and evaluates models on reasoning, mathematics, coding, language, and data analysis tasks with a public leaderboard.

name: ARC Prize
description: Nonprofit competition and research initiative around the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus, publishing benchmark datasets, leaderboards, and grants to advance general-purpose AI reasoning research.

name: F-Droid
description: Installable catalog of free and open-source Android applications with reproducible builds, a client app, and a documented JSON API for package metadata.

name: Homebrew Formulae
description: Online index of Homebrew package formulas for macOS and Linux, listing install statistics, dependencies, and version history, with a documented JSON API for every formula and cask.

name: pub.dev
description: Official package repository for Dart and Flutter, publishing open-source packages and plugins with search, hosted version documentation, and platform and SDK compatibility scoring.

name: Swift Package Index
description: Community index of Swift packages showing build compatibility across Apple platforms and Swift versions, dependency information, and package quality metadata.

name: LuaRocks
description: Package manager and public repository for Lua modules, hosting rock files with versioned releases, dependency declarations, and command-line installation tooling.

name: Clojars
description: Community repository for Clojure libraries distributing jars via Maven coordinates, with simple publishing, dependency snippets, and free hosting for open-source Clojure projects.

name: ROS Index
description: Searchable index of packages for the Robot Operating System ecosystem, aggregating repositories, documentation, and release information across ROS and ROS 2 distributions.

name: cppreference.com
description: Community-maintained reference documentation for the C and C++ standard libraries and language features, with per-version pages, compiler support tables, and content licensed under CC BY-SA.

name: PHP Manual
description: Official PHP language and standard library documentation in many languages, covering syntax, functions, extensions, configuration, and migration guides, with user-contributed notes.

name: Apache Kafka documentation
description: Official documentation for Apache Kafka covering concepts, configuration, design, implementation, and operations for the distributed event streaming platform, maintained by the Apache project community.

name: scikit-learn documentation
description: Official documentation for the scikit-learn machine learning library, with user guides, tutorials, API reference, and worked examples for classification, regression, clustering, and preprocessing.

name: TensorFlow
description: Official site and documentation for TensorFlow, the open machine learning framework, including guides, API references for Python and JavaScript, and deployment tutorials.

name: GitHub Docs
description: Official documentation for GitHub covering repositories, Actions, security features, administration, and APIs, with searchable guides for users, organizations, and enterprise administrators.

name: OpenCV documentation
description: Reference documentation and tutorials for OpenCV, the open-source computer vision library, covering modules for image processing, video analysis, machine learning, and camera calibration.

name: 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project)
description: Partnership of regional telecommunications standards bodies that produces cellular system specifications including LTE and 5G, with all technical specifications freely downloadable.

name: DIN (German Institute for Standardization)
description: German national standards body developing and publishing DIN standards across industry and services, and coordinating German participation in European and international standardization.

name: AFNOR Group
description: French standards association coordinating the development of national NF standards and representing France in European and international standardization, with standards sales and certification services.

name: Standards Australia
description: Australian national standards body developing AS standards across engineering, safety, and construction, and representing Australia in ISO and IEC international committees.

name: JSON Schema
description: Community specification and documentation site for JSON Schema, the vocabulary for annotating and validating JSON documents, with per-draft specifications, guides, and a registry of dialects.

name: NIST Computer Security Resource Center
description: NIST program site publishing security standards and guidelines, including FIPS publications, the Special Publication 800 series, and cryptographic module validation program information.
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

name: JATS (Journal Article Tag Suite)
description: NLM-maintained standard defining XML elements for journal article content, used by PubMed Central and many publishers, with the tag library, sample files, and version history.

name: Japan Patent Office
description: Japanese government agency granting patents, utility models, designs, and trademarks, publishing examination standards, statistics, and the J-PlatPat search service.

name: Korean Intellectual Property Office
description: South Korean government office responsible for patents, utility models, designs, and trademarks, publishing IP examination information, statistics, and policy documents through its Korean-language portal.

name: Intellectual Property Office (United Kingdom)
description: UK government agency for patents, designs, trademarks, and copyright policy, with official guidance, application services, registers, and IP statistics on GOV.UK.

name: Intellectual Property Office of Singapore
description: Singapore national IP office administering patent, trademark, and registered design filings, publishing e-services, guides, and registry search tools for businesses and researchers.

name: PatentsView
description: USPTO-funded research platform providing disambiguated patent data on inventors, assignees, and locations, with search tools and documented APIs for patent analytics.
publisher: United States Patent and Trademark Office

name: WIPO Lex
description: World Intellectual Property Organization database of IP laws, treaties, and judicial decisions from around the world, with multilingual search and country profile collections.

name: WIPO Global Brand Database
description: WIPO search platform covering international and national trademark collections, names, emblems, and domain identifiers, supporting clearance searches across multiple registers.
